 Follow Donnie Wahlberg and “Blue Bloods” Brother Will Estes Settle a ‘Beef’ as They Reunite in “Boston Blue” Clip (Exclusive)
 PEOPLE has an exclusive clip of Will Estes returning as ‘Blue Bloods’ favorite Jamie Reagan in the Friday, Nov. 6, episode of CBS’s ‘Boston Blue’
 Brenton Blanchet Thu, November 5, 2026 at 7:00 PM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Will Estes and Donnie Wahlberg in ‘Boston Blue’Credit: CBS NEED TO KNOW
 Donnie Wahlberg and Will Estes get into a brotherly spat in the next episode of Boston Blue 
 PEOPLE has an exclusive clip of Estes' return to the Blue Bloods universe as Jamie Reagan
 New episodes of Boston Blue arrive Fridays on CBS
 No Reagan family reunion is complete without a little investigative work (and a friendly disagreement or two).
 Will Estes reprises his Blue Bloods role of Jamie Reagan in the next episode of Boston Blue , arriving on CBS this Friday, Nov. 6, and PEOPLE has an exclusive sneak peek at the "joint investigation" he handles with his older bother, Danny ( Donnie Wahlberg ). In the clip, Jamie and Danny try to squash a brotherly "beef" as they follow a lead.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The fifth episode of season 2, "Blood Diamonds," finds Jamie's visit to Boston — where his brother is now stationed as part of the Boston Police Department — taking an "unexpected turn," per a synopsis from CBS. He and Danny are "drawn into a diamond heist linked to a violent family feud, forcing the brothers to confront lingering tensions of their own."
 Will Estes and Donnie Wahlberg in 'Boston Blue' 
 Credit: CBS 
 In the footage, Danny and Jamie can be seen walking through the streets of Boston as they get into a spat over who gets to take charge of things. "Look, is this beef gonna be a problem, or are we gonna keep it professional?" Danny asks Jamie, his former NYPD colleague.
 "I've never not been professional," Jamie says, as Danny responds, "That's not an answer."
 "Yeah, well as long as you can follow an order, I think we'll be fine," Jamie quips.
 Advertisement Advertisement Despite Danny reminding his brother that it's "my city," Jamie clarifies that his boss "knows I outrank you" even though they now work for different departments. "Let's agree to disagree," Danny says.
 Danny and Jamie then approach a man whose diamonds were stolen and break into a good-cop-bad-cop routine as the man asks them to "stop whatever this is."
 "You wanna stop trying to get the last word?" Jamie asks his brother, who responds with, "If you would toughen up, you might've got the last word."
 Wahlberg, 57, and Estes, 48, starred alongside each other in Blue Bloods from 2010 to 2024, before the show wrapped after 14 seasons. Boston Blue , starring Wahlberg and Sonequa Martin-Green , began in October 2025.
 Advertisement Advertisement Estes isn't the first Reagan family member to join Wahlberg in Boston. Other relative returnees from Blue Bloods have included Len Cariou and Bridget Moynahan. Speaking with PEOPLE last month, Wahlberg reiterated that he's hopeful for an onscreen reunion with former costar Tom Selleck , who played Frank Regan throughout the original series. "I learned so much from him, and I have the utmost respect for him. I love him and I miss him," Wahlberg said. "I want him to be on the show at some point."
 Also in the new episode, Mae "faces a difficult case after swatting results in a man's death, Lena investigates a series of suspicious deaths linked to one of Reverend Peters' parishioners and Sarah and Seth encounter an unexpected hurdle while planning their wedding," per a synopsis.
 Boston Blue airs Friday, Nov. 6, at 10 p.m. ET on CBS and streams the next day on Paramount+.
